description: Returns the seats of the hall of one session of Cavea that has not started: each row, each seat with its class, a mark for a taken seat, and a mark for special needs. Gives the count of free seats and the price in lari of each seat class. The server reads the map at each call. It reserves no seat. A person buys the ticket on cavea.ge. Data from the web site of Cavea, cavea.ge.

language.description: The language of the names and the texts: ka or en. The default is en.

session.description: The session code from cinema_list_sessions, for example cag_5/27-10-2026/22:15.

name: cinema_get_seat_map

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the seats, RFC 3339.

classes.description: Each seat class of the hall, with its price and its free seats.

class.description: The seat class: economy, standard, vip, or status.

free.description: The count of seats of the class that are not taken.

price.description: The price of one ticket in lari, as a decimal string.

seats.description: The count of seats of the class.

rows.description: The rows, in the order of Cavea.

seats.description: The seats of the row, by number.

special_needs.description: True for a seat for a person with special needs.

taken.description: True when Cavea marks the seat as taken. A person cannot buy it.

session.description: The session. It has no occupancy level.

audio_language.description: The language of the sound: ka or en.

formats.description: The formats of the session. Empty for a 2D session.

hall.description: The hall: a number or a name, for example 5 or IMAX.

prices.description: The price of each seat class. Standard only when the request has no movie.

class.description: The seat class: economy, standard, vip, or status.

price.description: The price of one ticket in lari, as a decimal string.

start.description: The start of the session, RFC 3339 with the offset of Tbilisi.

subtitle_language.description: The language of the subtitles: ka or en. Absent when the session has none.

source.description: The source of the data: Cavea.

title: Get the seat map of a session of Cavea
